_meta.title: What changed — PureScore v1 → the revamped HikmaEngine
_meta.intro: The biggest conceptual shifts from the original PureScore to the revamped engine. Status tracks build-readiness for the tech team; every “Where it lives” link is guard-checked against a real page so this stays a live navigation map, not a stale changelog.

status_legend.built: Implemented — engine + spec are live in this wiki
status_legend.spec: Designed / spec’d — documented, not yet fully built
status_legend.planned: Directional — intent set, detailed spec pending

changes.title: Sex, hormones & life-stage
changes.from: One unisex set of bands & pillar weights for everyone
changes.to: Bands, weights and reservoir dynamics reshaped by biological sex, hormonal milieu (cycle · pregnancy · menopause · andropause) and life-stage

changes.title: Pillars: 5 → 12
changes.to: 12 pillars — cardiovascular, metabolic, renal, hepatic, inflammation, hematologic, endocrine, body-composition, nutrition, sleep, fitness, mental/cognitive

changes.title: Wearable metrics: 2 → 19
changes.to: 19 metrics across recovery, sleep, cardiorespiratory fitness, activity and continuous monitoring — resting HR, HRV (RMSSD), SpO₂, skin-temp deviation, total sleep, sleep efficiency, sleep regularity, deep+REM, overnight SpO₂/ODI (apnea), nighttime HR/HRV recovery, VO₂max, steps, MVPA, sedentary time, HR recovery, gait speed, CGM time-in-range, CGM glycemic variability, home BP — each pillar-tagged with trust tiers & personal baselines

changes.title: BIOMONIAC reservoirs — assets & burden
changes.from: Point-in-time snapshot — no latent state or momentum
changes.to: 15 connected reservoirs of accumulated assets & burden, multivariate and κ-coupled across pillars, giving the score momentum, hysteresis and lead/lag

changes.title: User goals
changes.to: First-class user goals captured by progressive profiling and/or mined from chat sessions, steering scoring and the action engine

changes.title: Onboarding · progressive profiling · PRO
changes.to: Progressive onboarding that fills the profile over time, plus Patient-Reported Outcomes (PROs) feeding the engine

changes.title: NextBestAction → health outcomes
changes.to: NextBestAction explicitly optimised to improve health OUTCOMES (not just engagement) — ranked by outcome impact

changes.title: Knobs & multi-horizon forecast
changes.from: Static score — no what-if or projection
changes.to: Adjustable knobs that forecast PureScore and per-pillar trajectories over 90 / 180 / 365 days (live single-point recompute is built today; the time-horizon projection is the spec’d extension)
